messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps[shuttle]:Execution halted
parts:
If your app works in general, and only crashes unpredictably/randomly, this usually points to a memory issue. You can configure your application with more memory and see if that makes a difference. Please refer to the guide, section called "Configuring Shiny Applications" for instructions.

Also, for shinyapps.io specific questions and issues, you might also also want to post them here:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users

Best,
Fereshteh
